title: A WKB-related time-stepping scheme for differential equations describing oscillatory systems
summary: In this study, we present a novel time-stepping scheme for multiscale differential equations describing oscillatory systems with well-separated scales, where the scale separation is controlled by a small parameter $ε$. The time-stepping method is related to a multi-modal WKB approximation and relies on a transformation of variables derived in this work. The analysis reveals that, in the transformed formulation, the leading-order oscillations are either eliminated or appear only at higher asymptotic order.
